profile.headline: Lead Launch Telemetry and Software Engineer at Virgin Orbit
profile.jobTitle: Lead Launch Telemetry and Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Obtain a full time position focused on electronic systems in a progressive company that will apply and nurture my technical skills

Specialties: RF telemetry, Rocket tracking, RF Test, LabVIEW, c,  c + +,  circuit design, html,  java,  logic,  matlab, optical fibers  pspice, verilog,

positions.title: Lead Launch Telemetry and Software Engineer
positions.description:
Planned, designed, implemented, troubleshot and operated a worldwide network of ground stations that successfully tracked the Virgin Orbit L1 (LauncherOne) rocket on its first successful orbital mission in January 2021

Responsible for RF telemetry decisions and implementation from end to end

Did RF link budget analysis for VO L1 rocket

Involved in trajectory design by providing feedback to Guidance and Navigation team

Selected 2nd stage rocket transmitter antennas with a trade study

Selected tracking and receiver technology for ground stations

Selected RF telemetry data format

Wrote software that successfully tracked the VO L1 rocket (using LabVIEW)

Wrote software that successfully received and parsed telemetry data from VO L1 rocket (using LabVIEW)

Planned and implemented RF hardware and ground station testing in preparation for launch campaign.

Planned, led, and operated ground stations during the launch campaign that led to the  first successful VO L1 orbital mission.

Coordinated and incorporated to launch campaign a group of external ground station partners around the world

positions.title: Lead Launch Telemetry and Software Engineer
positions.description:
Same as Virgin Orbit role. Company name changed

Made logistical decisions for deployment of equipment on worldwide network of ground stations to track VO L1 rocket and receive RF telemetry from it

Involved in the planning and installation of a parabolic dish in VO headquarters using a helicopter

Traveled and selected a location for ground station in Latin America with a trade study

Involved in logistical and technical decisions to build ground station in Latin America from the ground up (including but not limited to tracking, receiver, network technology, facilities)

Shipped and tested equipment for ground station in Antarctica

Led initial communication with FCC and DoD for S-Band licensing

Led communication with NASA for potential use of TDRSS for space based telemetry

positions.title: RF Systems Engineer
positions.description:
•	Implemented semiconductor power amplifier test plans (power efficiency, ACLR, etc.) for the following standards using NI LabVIEW, NI TestStand and .NET C/C# on the NI STS platform: TDSCDMA, GSM, LTE, 802.11n,ac 
•	Developed benchmark software for high throughput multi-channel RF record and playback for NI Vector Signal Transceiver 5644R/45R/46R
•	Implemented IQ Gain imbalance and phase skew corrections to raw ADC bi-channel FlexRIO FPGA instrument ni5782/ni7966R
•	Developed test software for calibration and VNA measurements for RF switching hardware
•	NI Week presenter: Automated test with NI TestStand, FPGA extension technologies for test time improvement and RF business opportunities
•	USTTI presenter: Radio Spectral Monitoring and Measuring

positions.title: Automated Test Systems Engineer
positions.description:
•	Participated in global deployment of automated test systems in different cities in Asia for a large electronics manufacturing customer 
•	Developed .NET C wrappers for NI WLAN toolkit for 802.11ac testing
•	Developed LV DUT control code for CSR Bluetooth chipsets

positions.title: Research Assistant 				Optics Laboratory
positions.description:
Fabricated optical fiber electric field sensors.
Conducted physical tests of new packaging scheme to protect optical fiber sensors.

positions.title: Teacher Assistant
positions.description: Taught review sessions for analog circuit design course covering Operational Amplifiers, BJTs, MOSFETs.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Modeled sensor arrays for ultrasound cameras in automobile applications using MATLAB. RISE program of the German Academic Exchange Service DAAD.

positions.title: Teacher Assistant
positions.description:
Taught review and homework help sessions for Fourier Analysis class of 60 students.
Received positive evaluations from students for effectively clarifying complex concepts.
